blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: 4D scene reconstruction aims to recover the evolving geometry, appearance, and motion of dynamic environments from visual observations. Despite substantial progress in neural scene representations, reconstructing dynamic scenes remains challenging due to non-rigid motion, occlusions, temporal inconsistencies, and the trade-offs between reconstruction fidelity and computational efficiency. Recent advances in Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) and 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) have introduced diverse approaches to representing and reconstructing dynamic scenes, yet their relationships, underlying design choices, and evaluation protocols remain fragmented. In this paper, we present a unified perspective on 4D scene reconstruction, organizing existing methods around their scene representations, temporal modeling strategies, reconstruction pipelines, and optimization objectives. Through this framework, we examine how different design choices affect geometric fidelity, appearance consistency, motion representation, and computational efficiency. We further consolidate commonly used datasets and evaluation metrics, identify limitations in current experimental practices, and discuss open challenges in reconstructing complex, dynamic real-world environments. By connecting methodological developments with their underlying assumptions and evaluation evidence, this work provides a structured foundation for understanding existing approaches and identifying future research directions. An evolving collection of relevant papers and resources is available at the project webpage .
blocks.zh: 4D场景重建旨在从视觉观测中恢复变化中的几何,外观,动态环境的运动. 尽管在神经场景表现方面取得了实质性进展,但由于非刚性运动,隔离,时间不一致,以及重建忠心与计算效率之间的权衡,重建动态场景仍然具有挑战性. 神经辐射场(NERF)和3D高斯镀层(3DGS)最近的进步引入了代表和重建动态场景的多种方法,然而它们的关系,基础设计选择和评价协议仍然支离破碎. 在本文中,我们提出了关于4D场景重建的统一观点,围绕他们的场景表现,时间建模战略,重建管道,以及优化目标,组织现有方法. 通过这个框架,我们研究不同的设计选择如何影响几何忠诚度,外观的一致性,运动表现和计算效率. 我们进一步整合常用数据集和评价衡量标准,找出当前实验做法的局限性,并讨论重建复杂,动态现实世界环境的公开挑战. 通过将方法发展与其基本假设和评价证据联系起来,这项工作为了解现有方法和确定未来的研究方向提供了结构化的基础。 有关文件和资源正在逐步收集,可在项目网页上查阅。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en: Scene reconstruction is a core problem in robotics and spatial AI, aiming to recover the three-dimensional structure and appearance of real-world environments from multi-view observations. It remains a fundamental challenge in computer vision and graphics, with applications spanning navigation, scene understanding, and novel view synthesis [ 182 , 42 , 169 , 67 , 170 ] . Considerable efforts have been devoted to developing methods for dense, accurate, and high-fidelity reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 场景重建是机器人和空间AI中的一个核心问题,旨在从多景观测中恢复现实世界环境的三维结构和外观. 它仍然是计算机视觉和图形方面的一个基本挑战,应用包括导航、场景理解和新视觉合成[182、42、169、67、170]。 已作出很大努力,制定密集、准确和高度诚实的重建方法。

blocks.en: The field has evolved substantially over the past three decades. Early approaches were based on classical geometric pipelines, with Structure from Motion (SfM) and Multi-View Stereo (MVS) forming the foundation of three-dimensional reconstruction. SfM estimates camera poses and sparse scene geometry via feature matching and bundle adjustment, while MVS densifies these reconstructions using photometric consistency across calibrated views, producing detailed surface models of static scenes [ 117 , 102 , 120 , 118 , 124 ] . Despite their effectiveness, these methods are limited by computational efficiency and their reliance on hand-crafted features and geometric assumptions.
blocks.zh: 过去30年来,该领域发生了实质性变化。 早期的方法以古典几何管为基础,结构从运动(SfM)和多维立体(MVS)构成三维重建的基础. SfM通过特征匹配和捆绑调整来估计相机的姿势和稀疏的场景几何,而MVS则使用校准视图的光度一致性来变密这些重建,产生静态场景的详细表面模型[117,102,120,118,124]. 尽管这些方法很有效,但由于计算效率以及依赖手工制作的特征和几何假设,这些方法受到限制.

blocks.en: With the development of Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) [ 10 ] , scene reconstruction has progressed from offline batch processing to online frameworks that jointly perform camera tracking and environment mapping. However, traditional geometric pipelines remain sensitive to noise in incremental inputs, leading to cumulative trajectory drift and motion-induced artifacts that degrade reconstruction quality over time [ 101 , 170 ] .
blocks.zh: 随着同步本地化和绘图(SLAM)的开发[10],场景重建从离线批次处理进展到联合进行相机跟踪和环境绘图的在线框架. 然而,传统的几何管仍然对增量投入中的噪音敏感,导致累积的轨迹漂移和运动引起的文物随着时间的推移而降解重建质量[101,170].

blocks.en: Fig. 1: Trends in 4D reconstruction. The increasing adoption of NeRF- and GS-based methods for dynamic scene modeling has led to a rapid growth in related publications in recent years.
blocks.zh: 费格。 1:4D重建趋势. 以NERF和GS为基础的动态场景建模方法日益采用,导致近年来相关出版物迅速增长。

blocks.en: The field has undergone a paradigm shift with the advent of deep learning and neural representations. Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) [ 97 ] represent scenes as continuous implicit functions, enabling high-quality view synthesis. Subsequent extensions have improved training efficiency, rendering speed, and robustness [ 36 , 114 , 166 , 168 ] . More recently, 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) [ 54 ] has emerged as an effective alternative, representing scenes with anisotropic 3D Gaussians and leveraging a differentiable tile-based rasterizer for real-time rendering while preserving fine details. These approaches depart from discrete geometric representations and instead learn continuous scene representations that capture complex geometry and appearance.
blocks.zh: 随着深入学习和神经表达的出现,这个领域经历了范式的转变. 神经辐射场(NERF)[97]代表场景作为连续的隐含功能,能够进行高质量的视图合成. 随后的延长提高了培训效率、渲染速度和强度[36、114、166、168]。 最近,3D Gaussian Splating(3DGS)[54]作为一个有效的替代品出现,代表场景有异构的3D Gaussians,并利用一个不同的瓦片基的光栅进行实时渲染,同时保留精细的细节. 这些方法脱离了离散的几何表示法,而是学习了连续的场景表示法来捕捉复杂的几何和外观.

blocks.en: Despite advances in static scene modeling, extending reconstruction to dynamic environments introduces substantially greater complexity. High-fidelity 4D reconstruction must address the ambiguities of non-rigid motion, preserve long-range spatio-temporal coherence, and disentangle time-varying radiance from geometric deformation.
blocks.zh: 尽管在静态场景建模方面取得了进展,但将重建扩大到动态环境却带来了更大的复杂性。 高纯度4D重建必须解决非刚性运动的模糊性,保持长距离的时空一致性,以及从几何变形中分解出时间变化的光度.

blocks.en: The rapid development of 4D dynamic reconstruction, driven by the transition from implicit neural representations to explicit Gaussian primitives, has led to an increasingly diverse and fragmented research landscape [ 78 , 122 , 167 , 65 , 165 ] . As illustrated in Fig. 1 , the field is undergoing a shift in design choices, with evolving trade-offs among rendering speed, temporal consistency, and memory efficiency. This survey is motivated by the need to consolidate recent advances into a coherent framework and provide a structured reference for both established methods and emerging approaches such as 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS).
blocks.zh: 4D动态重建的快速发展,由隐含的神经表征向明确的高斯原始体过渡,导致研究景观日益多样化和分散[78,122,167,65,165]. 如图1所示,外地在设计选择方面正发生转变,在渲染速度、时间一致性和内存效率之间不断作出权衡。 本次调查的动机是需要将最近的进展整合为一个连贯的框架,并为既定方法和新出现的方法提供结构化的参考,如4D高斯镀层(4DGS).

blocks.en:
Existing surveys [ 36 , 157 , 29 , 154 , 4 , 11 , 137 ] primarily focus on static neural rendering and often treat dynamic reconstruction as a secondary topic. As a result, a systematic review of 4D dynamic reconstruction using scene-specific optimization remains lacking.
In this survey, we focus on the two principal paradigms for scene-specific optimization in dynamic reconstruction: implicit 4D Neural Radiance Fields (4D NeRF) and explicit 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS). While classical Simultaneous Localization and Mapping (SLAM) and Structure from Motion (SfM) provide the geometric foundation for camera tracking and mapping, they are typically predicated on rigid-body assumptions or sparse representations. Emerging feed-forward, generalizable 4D reconstruction approaches enable rapid, offline-style inference across diverse scenes; however, they are fundamentally constrained by reliance on pre-trained dataset biases, often resulting in a fidelity ceiling in out-of-distribution scenarios.
We emphasize per-scene optimization approaches, which remain the gold standard for achieving high-fidelity reconstruction and temporal consistency. Both 4D NeRF and 4DGS mitigate the generalization gap of feed-forward models by anchoring reconstruction to scene-specific observations, rather than the statistical priors of a training set.
Furthermore, we analyze the performance of representative methods on benchmark datasets and discuss key open challenges for future research.
blocks.zh:
现有的调查[36,157,29,154,4,11,137]主要侧重于静态神经渲染,并经常将动态重建作为次要话题. 因此,仍然缺乏对利用场景特定优化进行的4D动态重建的系统审查。
在本次调查中,我们侧重于动态重建中场景特定优化的两大范式:隐含的 4D神经辐射场(4D NERF)和清晰的4D高斯电镀(4DGS). 虽然古典同时本地化和绘图(SLAM)和结构从运动(SfM)为照相机的跟踪和绘图提供了几何学基础,但它们通常以刚性的身体假设或稀疏的表示为基础。 新出现的向导、可通用的四维重建方法可以使各种场景迅速、离线式的推论得以进行;然而,它们根本上受到依赖事先经过培训的数据集偏差的限制,这往往导致在分配外情况下的忠诚度上限。
我们强调场景优化办法,这仍然是实现高度诚信重建和时间一致性的黄金标准。 4D NERF和4DGS都通过将重建锚定在具体现场观测上,而不是一个培训集的统计前身,来缩小向馈送模型的通俗化差距.
此外,我们分析基准数据集的代表性方法的绩效,并讨论未来研究面临的重大公开挑战。

blocks.en: II Preliminaries
blocks.zh: 二. 初步情况

blocks.en: II-A History of Dynamic Scene Reconstruction
blocks.zh: II-A 动态景区重建史

blocks.en: As shown in Fig. 1 , dynamic scene reconstruction has evolved over the past two decades from geometry-based pipelines to learning-based methods and, more recently, to implicit neural representations. The introduction of NeRF established 4D reconstruction as a central research direction, further accelerated by 3DGS. This has led to rapid growth in recent work. This section reviews this progression and highlights key developments underlying modern radiance field and Gaussian-based approaches.
blocks.zh: 如图1所示,在过去20年里,动态场景重建已经从基于几何学的管道演变为基于学习的方法,最近又演变为隐含的神经表达. NERF的引入将4D重建作为中心研究方向,由3DGS进一步加速. 这导致最近的工作迅速增长。 本节审查这一进展,并重点介绍现代光学领域和高斯方法背后的关键发展。

blocks.en: Classical Approaches: From Geometry to Volumetric Fusion (Pre 2015). Early work was dominated by geometry-based pipelines. Multi-view stereo (MVS) and structure-from-motion (SfM) were extended to dynamic settings, leading to non-rigid SfM (NRSfM) [ 17 ] and template-based mesh tracking [ 19 ] . These methods estimate per-frame geometry and track deformations relative to a canonical model. In parallel, depth sensors enabled volumetric fusion methods, such as KinectFusion [ 99 ] and DynamicFusion [ 98 ] , which integrate depth maps into a canonical volume with non-rigid alignment.
blocks.zh: 传统方法: 从几何到卷曲融合(2015年前). 早期工程以几何式管道为主. 多视图立体声(MVS)和结构自动(SfM)被扩展至动态设置,导致非刚性SfM(NRSfM)[17]和基于模板的网格跟踪[19]. 这些方法估计每帧几何和轨迹的变形相对于一个舟体模型. 同时,深度传感器启用了量子聚变方法,如KinectFusion[99]和DynamicFusion[98],它们将深度图集成到一个有非刚性对齐的犬体卷中.

blocks.en: These approaches have several limitations. Explicit geometry restricts modeling of complex deformations and topology changes. Per-frame optimization limits scalability for long sequences and high-resolution scenes. Appearance modeling is also limited, typically relying on texture maps and lacking view-dependent effects.
blocks.zh: 这些办法有一些局限性。 明确的几何学限制了复杂变形和地形变化的模型化. 每帧优化限制了长序和高分辨率场景的可伸缩性. 外观建模也很有限,一般依靠纹理图,缺乏依赖视图的效果.

blocks.en: Transition to Learning-based Models (2015–2020). With the rise of deep learning, reconstruction methods began incorporating learned priors. Early works [ 175 , 140 , 20 , 49 , 141 , 146 ] improved components such as depth, scene flow, and pose estimation, while retaining classical pipelines. A key shift was the adoption of implicit representations, including occupancy networks [ 96 ] and neural SDFs [ 103 ] , which model scenes as continuous fields. These representations are more expressive and compact, and enable dynamic extensions.
blocks.zh: 向学习模式过渡(2015-2020年). 随着深入学习的兴起,重建方法开始吸收学到的前科. 早期作品[175,140,20,49,141,146]改进了深度,场景流量等组件,并提出了估计,同时保留了古典管线. 一个关键的转变是采用了隐含的表示方式,包括占用网络[96]和神经SDF[103],将场景作为连续的场景模式. 这些表述更加表达和紧凑,能够动态扩展。

blocks.en:
Dynamic NeRFs and Implicit Radiance Fields (2020–2023). Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) [ 97 ] enable high-quality novel view synthesis by modeling scenes as continuous radiance fields. Dynamic variants, such as D-NeRF [ 110 ] , Nerfies [ 105 ] , and HyperNeRF [ 106 ] , represent scenes using canonical fields with deformation models. These methods capture complex non-rigid motion.
However, dynamic NeRFs are computationally expensive. Training often requires long runtimes, and inference is slow due to volumetric rendering. Temporal consistency remains difficult over long sequences. Later methods, including TiNeuVox [ 27 ] and NSFF [ 75 ] , introduce explicit structures or motion priors to improve efficiency, but scalability remains limited.
blocks.zh:
动态NERFs和隐形辐射场(2020–2023). 神经辐射场(NERF)[97]通过建模场景作为连续的辐射场来进行高质量的新视觉合成. 动态变体,如D-NERF [110],Nerfies [105],以及HyperNERF [106],代表场景使用带有变形模型的犬形场. 这些方法捕捉复杂的非刚性运动.
然而,动态的NERF在计算上是昂贵的. 训练往往需要长跑时间,由于体积渲染,推论缓慢. 在较长的序列中,时间的一致性仍然很困难。 后期方法,包括TiNeuVox [27] 和NSFF [75],引入了明确的结构或运动前缀来提高效率,但可扩展性仍然有限.

blocks.en:
Dynamic 3D Gaussian Splatting (2023–Present). Gaussian Splatting (GS) [ 54 ] represents scenes as sets of anisotropic 3D Gaussians with learnable parameters, including position, scale, opacity, rotation, and appearance. Dynamic extensions incorporate temporal modeling through deformation or per-frame transformations, leading to 4D Gaussian Splatting (4DGS).
GS enables real-time rendering via rasterization. Its explicit structure facilitates handling occlusions and non-rigid motion. Each Gaussian jointly encodes geometry and appearance, yielding a compact representation.
However, dynamic GS methods often require many primitives, leading to high memory usage [ 44 , 180 ] . Improving efficiency and scalability remains an open problem.
blocks.zh:
动态3D高斯白板(2023–Present). Gaussian Splating (GS) [54] 代表场景为一组具有可学习参数的异同位素3D高斯人,包括位置,尺度,不透明,旋转,和外观. 动态扩展包含通过变形或每帧变换来的时间模型,导致4D高斯电镀(4DGS).
GS通过光栅化实现实时渲染. 其明确结构有利于处理隔离和非硬性运动。 每个高斯人联合编码几何和外观,产生一个紧凑的表示.
然而,动态GS方法往往需要许多原始方法,导致内存使用率高[44,180]. 提高效率和可扩展性仍然是一个尚未解决的问题。

blocks.en: II-B Representing Radiance Fields
blocks.zh: II-B 代表辐射场

blocks.en: Recent advances in radiance field representations have improved 4D scene reconstruction, enabling high-fidelity modeling of geometry and appearance over time. Both NeRF and 3DGS represent scenes as radiance fields but differ in formulation. NeRF models the scene implicitly using a neural network that maps 3D coordinates and viewing directions to color and density. In contrast, 3DGS represents the scene explicitly with anisotropic 3D Gaussians optimized for efficient rendering. We briefly review these approaches and summarize their differences in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 最近在光度实地表现方面的进步改善了4D场景重建,使得几何学和外观的高度真实性能够随时间演变。 NERF和3DGS都代表场景作为辐射场,但配方不同. NERF模拟了该场景,隐含地使用一个神经网络,将3D坐标和查看方向映射到颜色和密度. 相比之下,3DGS则用异构的3D Gaussians为高效渲染进行了优化,明确代表了场景. 我们简要回顾这些办法,并总结图2中的差异。

blocks.en: II-C Comparison with Existing Surveys
blocks.zh: 与现有调查的比较

blocks.en: Recent advances in radiance field representations have driven the development of 4D reconstruction methods based on NeRF and 3DGS, with applications across diverse domains. Table I compares recent surveys in this area. Our survey provides broader coverage by including both NeRF- and GS-based methods, summarizing commonly used datasets and evaluation protocols, and incorporating a quantitative analysis for performance comparison.
blocks.zh: 最近在光度外地代表方面取得的进展促使开发了基于NERF和3DGS的4D重建方法,其应用跨越不同领域。 图表 我比较了最近在这一领域的调查。 我们的调查涵盖范围更广,包括基于NERF和GS的方法,总结常用数据集和评价协议,并纳入定量分析,用于业绩比较。

blocks.en: Among existing works, Zhu et al. [ 194 ] is most closely related, but covers fewer methods (52 vs. 102) and datasets (10 vs. 22), and omits several scene types, such as autonomous driving. In addition, it does not provide a unified taxonomy or a comprehensive evaluation. This survey aims to offer a structured and comprehensive reference for 4D scene reconstruction.

blocks.en: III-A Preliminaries of 4D NeRF
blocks.zh: 4D NERF的序言

blocks.en: To extend static NeRF to dynamic scenes, temporal dynamics are incorporated by introducing a time dimension into the radiance field formulation. As shown in Fig. 3 , existing approaches adopt different strategies to encode temporal information within neural radiance fields. Based on the taxonomy in Table II , these methods can be categorized into four main classes.

These approaches improve coherence and can be combined with other designs.

blocks.en: III-B Deformation-Field-Based Methods
blocks.zh: 三-B 变形-外地方法

blocks.en:
These methods extend static NeRF by maintaining a canonical 3D representation and learning deformation functions D ⁡ ( 𝐱 , t ) → 𝐱 ′ D(\mathbf{x},t)\rightarrow\mathbf{x}^{\prime} to model temporal variations.
To address non-rigid reconstruction without explicit geometry, early methods employ deformation MLPs to map spatio-temporal coordinates into a canonical space, e.g., D-NeRF [ 110 ] . On the other hand, NR-NeRF [ 138 ] introduces rigidity regularization to improve temporal correspondence. However, these methods remain less effective in the presence of significant topological changes or large displacements due to the limitations of a single continuous deformation field.
blocks.zh:
这些方法将静态的NERF延伸,维持了犬形的3D表示和学习变形函数D → (x, t) → × D(\ mathbf{x}, t)\ rightarrow\ mathbf{xX}^{\prime} 到时间变化模型.
为了解决没有明确几何特征的非硬化重建问题,早期的方法使用变形MLP将spatio-时空坐标映射到一个峡谷空间,例如D-NERF [110]. 另一方面,NR-NERF[138]引入了僵硬的规范化,以改善时间通信. 然而,由于单一持续变形场的局限性,在出现重大地形变化或大规模迁移的情况下,这些方法仍然不太有效。

blocks.en: For complex scenes with articulated structures or multiple interacting objects, global deformation fields are often insufficient to capture localized motions. STAR [ 179 ] , Total-Recon [ 33 ] , and NDR [ 7 ] address this limitation by factorizing scenes into motion-aware canonical subspaces. With trajectory-based constraints, these methods jointly optimize geometry, camera poses, and non-rigid transformations. However, the optimization process remains computationally expensive and sensitive to the quality of the initial trajectory or pose estimates.
blocks.zh: 对于具有清晰结构或多个相互作用物体的复杂场景,全球变形场往往不足以捕捉局部运动. STAR [179],Total-Recon [33],以及NDR [7]通过将场景纳入运动意识的舟子空间来解决这一限制. 在基于轨迹的制约下,这些方法共同优化了几何,相机的姿势,以及非刚性变换. 然而,优化过程在计算上仍然昂贵,对初始轨迹的质量很敏感,或者提出估计数。

blocks.en: Reconstructing high-fidelity dynamic radiance fields from sparse observations or uncalibrated cameras remains challenging. To improve stability, DeVRF [ 83 ] and RoDynRF [ 86 ] employ voxel-based representations for efficient canonicalization. These methods further incorporate auxiliary priors, such as monocular depth, disparity, and reprojection constraints, to jointly estimate camera motion and dynamic scene evolution. However, their performance depends heavily on the quality of the external priors, and inaccurate disparity estimates can introduce artifacts into the 4D representation.
blocks.zh: 利用稀少的观测或未校准的摄像头重建高纯度动态辐射场仍然具有挑战性。 为了提高稳定性,DEVRF[83]和RoDynRF[86]采用了以Voxel为基础的表示法,用于高效的犬科化. 这些方法进一步包括了辅助前科,如单元深度,差异,以及再投影限制,共同估计相机运动和动态场景演化. 然而,它们的性能在很大程度上取决于外部前科的质量,不准确的差价估计可以将文物引入4D代表.

blocks.en: Typical deformation models often struggle with view-dependent specularities and motion blur, leading to entangled geometry and appearance. To alleviate this issue, DyBluRF [ 131 ] and NeRF-DS [ 163 ] incorporate surface-normal conditioning and mask-guided deformation to separate transient appearance effects from scene geometry. However, modeling complex radiance variations remains challenging in regions with rapid motion or strong reflections, often resulting in blurred textures or residual artifacts.
blocks.zh: 典型的变形模型往往与视线依赖的光谱和运动模糊在一起挣扎,导致缠绕几何和外观. 为缓解这一问题,DyBluRF[131]和NERF-DS[163]结合了表面正常的调节和面具导变形,将瞬态外观效果与场景几何区分开来. 然而,在有快速运动或强烈反射的区域,模拟复杂的光度变化仍然具有挑战性,往往导致纹理模糊或残余文物.

blocks.en: III-C Implicit 4D Primitive-Based Methods
blocks.zh: 三-C 隐含的4D初级方法

blocks.en:
These methods extend NeRF by directly modeling dynamics through an explicit temporal dimension, where the radiance field is defined as F ⁡ ( 𝐱 , t , 𝐝 ) → ( σ , 𝐜 ) F(\mathbf{x},t,\mathbf{d})\rightarrow(\sigma,\mathbf{c}) . This formulation avoids canonical decomposition and provides a unified space-time representation.
To improve temporal coherence in dynamic scenes, several methods incorporate explicit motion fields into volumetric representations. NSFF [ 75 ] introduced neural scene flow fields to jointly optimize geometry, radiance, and dense 3D motion, while NeRFlow [ 21 ] coupled radiance fields with continuous flow for consistent monocular view synthesis. However, these methods remain sensitive to flow estimation errors, often producing artifacts or blurred geometry under rapid motion.
blocks.zh:
这些方法通过一个明确的时间维度直接建模动态来扩展NERF,其中辐射场的定义是F →(x, t, d) →(\, c) F(\ mathbf{x}, t,\ mathbf{d})\rightarrow(\sigma,\ mathbf{c}). 这种配方避免了犬形分解,提供了统一的时空代表.
为了提高动态场景中的时间一致性,几种方法将明确的运动场纳入音量表达. NSFF [75]引入了神经场景流场,以联合优化几何,光泽,以及密集的3D运动,而NERFlow [21]则将光泽场与连续流结合,用于一致的单视合成. 然而,这些方法对流估计误差仍然敏感,在快速运动下往往产生文物或模糊几何.

blocks.en: To address the under-constrained nature of monocular reconstruction, several works adopt static–dynamic decomposition. DynNeRF [ 34 ] and Video-NeRF [ 155 ] incorporate monocular depth priors to regularize geometry and appearance, enabling stable free-viewpoint rendering of dynamic content. DetNeRF [ 181 ] further extends this by employing occlusion-aware modeling to explicitly separate static backgrounds from moving components. The efficacy of these methods is strictly bounded by the quality of external priors
blocks.zh: 为解决单体重建不足的问题,一些作品采用了静态-动力分解. DynNERF [34] 和 Video-NERF [155] 包含单色深度前缀,使几何和外观规范化,使动态内容能够稳定的自由视点渲染. DetNERF [181] 进一步扩展了这一点,采用了隐形-意识模型,将静态背景与移动组件明确区分开来. 这些方法的功效严格取决于外部前科的质量

blocks.en: For long sequences and complex scenes with multiple moving agents, DecouplingNeRF [ 177 ] and ML-NSG [ 31 ] use hierarchical neural scene graphs to decompose scenes into object-centric components for scalable reconstruction. However, the hierarchical design introduces additional complexity, and these methods may struggle with objects exhibiting unpredictable motion or frequent occlusions.
blocks.zh: 对于有多个移动剂的长序和复杂场景,DecouplingNERF [177]和ML-NSG [31]使用分级神经场景图将场景分解为以物体为中心的组件,用于可伸缩重建. 然而,分级设计引入了额外的复杂性,这些方法可能会与表现出不可预知的运动或频繁的隐蔽的物体纠缠在一起.

blocks.en: Recent advances increasingly focus on modeling motion dynamics and incorporating non-RGB sensors. Sync-NeRF [ 56 ] and MonoNeRF [ 135 ] learn implicit velocity fields and feature correspondences to improve temporal alignment and robustness. Beyond RGB inputs, 4D-NDF [ 190 ] models LiDAR sequences using time-dependent signed distance functions (SDFs) to jointly reconstruct static structures and dynamic objects. However, velocity-based methods remain sensitive to temporal aliasing, while multimodal approaches are affected by modality-specific noise.
blocks.zh: 最近的进展越来越侧重于模拟运动动力学和纳入非RGB传感器。 Sync-NERF [56] 和 MonoNERF [135] 学习隐含的速度字段和特征对应,以提高时间的配合性和稳健性. 在RGB输入之外,4D-NDF[190]模型LiDAR序列使用时间依赖的签名距离函数(SDFs)联合重建静态结构和动态对象. 然而,基于速度的方法仍然对时间别名敏感,而多式联运方法则受到特定方式噪音的影响。

blocks.en: III-D 4D Feature-Volume-Based Methods
blocks.zh: III-D 4D 基于特性的组合方法

blocks.en: To improve efficiency, these methods replace implicit neural fields with structured representations that factorize the 4D space-time domain into lower-dimensional components. Common strategies include tensor decomposition, planar factorization, and multi-resolution grids, enabling faster training and rendering with reduced memory.
blocks.zh: 为了提高效率,这些方法用结构化的表示法取代隐性神经领域,将4D时空域纳入下维元件. 共同的策略包括拉伸分解,平板因子化,以及多分辨率的网格,使得能进行更快的培训和渲染,同时减少内存.

blocks.en: To reduce the computational cost of coordinate-based MLPs, several methods decompose 4D space into lower-dimensional representations. HexPlane [ 8 ] and K-Planes [ 32 ] project 4D volumes onto orthogonal 2D planes, while HyperReel [ 2 ] and MixVoxels [ 144 ] combine voxel grids with ray-conditioned sampling and deformation modeling. These factorizations enable efficient high-quality rendering through structured memory layouts, but often involve a trade-off between memory usage and spatial resolution.
blocks.zh: 为了降低基于坐标的MLP的计算成本,几种方法将4D空间分解为下维表示. HexPlane [8] 和 K-Planes [32] 项目 4D 卷向正交2D平面,而HyperReel [2] 和MixVoxels [144] 将voxel格子与射线条件取样和变形模型结合. 这些因子化使得通过结构化的内存布局可以高效地进行高质量的渲染,但往往涉及内存使用和空间分辨率之间的权衡.

blocks.en: To ensure smooth transitions between temporal snapshots, several methods incorporate temporal interpolation and frequency-aware modeling. TID-NeRF [ 107 ] integrates temporal modeling into explicit representations, while BLiRF [ 113 ] models radiance fields as band-limited signals using neural trajectory bases and low-rank spatial decomposition. NeRFPlayer [ 129 ] decomposes scenes into static and dynamic components with sliding-window temporal encoding. Ced-NeRF [ 82 ] improves generalization with hybrid grid-based representations, and DaReNeRF [ 88 ] encodes temporal information using direction-aware wavelet representations. However, high-frequency motion and abrupt topological changes are often blurred by the underlying spectral constraints or interpolation schemes.
blocks.zh: 为确保时间快照之间的平稳过渡,有几种方法包括时间插图和频率感知模型。 TID-NERF [107] 将时间模型整合到明确的表示中,而BLIRF [113] 模型辐射场作为波段有限的信号,使用神经轨迹基础和低位空间分解. NERFPlayer [129] 将场景分解为静态和动态组件,并带有滑窗时间编码. Ced-NERF [82] 改进了基于混合网格的表达式的概括化,DaReNERF [88] 使用方向感波表达法编码时间信息. 然而,高频运动和突如其来的地形变化往往由于基本的光谱限制或内插计划而模糊不清。

blocks.en: For large-scale scenes, hash-based encodings improve scalability. SUDS [ 139 ] and MSTH [ 143 ] utilize multiresolution hash grids with uncertainty-aware masking to handle complex urban dynamics, while NeuRAD [ 136 ] and RoDUS [ 100 ] incorporate rolling shutter compensation and semantic signals for robust performance in autonomous driving scenarios. EmerNeRF [ 171 ] and LiDAR4D [ 189 ] further extend these ideas to multimodal settings by using learned flow and temporal feature slots to aggregate information across sparse frames. However, hash-based representations may suffer from feature collisions in complex scenes, potentially introducing aliasing artifacts or geometric noise.
blocks.zh: 对于大型场景,基于散列的编码可以提高可扩展性. SUDS [139] 和MSTH [143] 利用多分辨率散列网,并带有不确定性意识的遮挡,处理复杂的城市动态,而NeURAD [136]和RoDUS [100] 则包含滚动的百叶窗补偿和语义信号,以便在自主驱动情况下具有强效性能. EmerNERF [171]和LiDAR4D [189] 利用学到的流量和时间特征槽,将这些想法进一步扩展至多式联运设置中,以汇总跨越稀疏框架的信息. 然而,基于散列的表示可能会在复杂的场景中受到特征碰撞的影响,有可能引入别名文物或几何噪声.

blocks.en: Hybrid representations support specialized tasks by incorporating domain-specific inductive biases. NVFi [ 69 ] introduces physics-informed velocity fields for motion transfer and future-state prediction, while Gear-NeRF [ 85 ] leverages semantic priors for object-level tracking and motion-aware sampling. Methods such as S-DyRF [ 73 ] further enable temporally consistent stylization in dynamic scenes. However, the reliance on specialized priors can limit generalization across diverse scenarios.
blocks.zh: 混合表述通过纳入特定领域的诱导偏差来支持专门任务。 NVFi [69] 引入物理学知情速度场用于运动转移和未来状态预测,而Gear-NERF [85] 则利用语义学前科进行物体级跟踪和运动意识取样. S-DyRF[73]等方法进一步在动态场景中实现时间一致性的阶梯化. 然而,对专业前科的依赖会限制对不同情景的概括。

blocks.en: III-E Temporal-Prior-Based Methods
blocks.zh: 三. 临时优先方法

blocks.en: While previous approaches explicitly parameterize time within the radiance field, practical reconstruction often benefits from external temporal cues used as constraints or guidance. These methods leverage signals such as optical flow, physical constraints, or sequential modeling to regularize the under-constrained dynamic reconstruction problem.
blocks.zh: 虽然以往的做法明确将时间参数化为光圈内的时间,但实际重建往往得益于作为限制或指导的外部时间提示。 这些方法利用光学流,物理约束等信号,或相继建模,使约束不足的动态重建问题规范化.

blocks.en: To support real-time and streaming applications, several frameworks replace global optimization with temporally incremental updates. StreamRF [ 71 ] , for example, employs a grid-based representation with sequential updates, modeling temporal evolution through incremental changes to a base model and enabling efficient streaming via difference-based compression. However, these methods are prone to error accumulation, where small update misalignments propagate over long sequences.
blocks.zh: 为了支持实时和流式应用,若干框架以时间递增的更新取代全球优化。 例如,StreatRF[71]采用基于网格的表示法,并按顺序更新,通过对基准模型的增量变化模拟时间演变,并通过基于差异的压缩实现高效率的流化。 然而,这些方法容易发生错位积累,在长序上传播小更新错位.

blocks.en:
For scenes with complex stochastic motion, OTNeRF [ 112 ] enforces temporal consistency by modeling scene dynamics as low-frequency shifts in pixel distributions. However, such statistical regularization often suppresses high-frequency geometric details.
In scenarios with sparse observations or severe occlusions, incorporating physics-based or geometric priors from non-RGB sensors becomes important. STGC-NeRF [ 178 ] introduces spatio-temporal geometric constraints for LiDAR-based reconstruction, using scene flow to establish cross-frame correspondences and improve robustness under sparse inputs. However, the effectiveness of these constraints depends heavily on motion estimation quality, and large inter-frame displacements can introduce temporal aliasing in high-speed scenes.
blocks.zh:
对于具有复杂结构运动的场景,OTNERF[112]通过模拟场景动态作为像素分布中的低频移位来强制时间一致性. 然而,这种统计规范化往往压制高频几何细节.
在观测很少或存在严重堵塞的情况下,将非RGB传感器的物理或几何前科纳入其中变得重要。 STGC-NERF [178]为基于LiDAR的重建引入了Spantio-时态几何限制,利用场景流来建立跨帧通信,并在稀疏投入下改善稳健性. 然而,这些制约因素的有效性在很大程度上取决于运动估计的质量,大型的帧间迁移可以在高速场景中引入时间别名.

blocks.en: IV DYNAMIC 3D GAUSSIAN SPLATTING
blocks.zh: 四. Dynamic 3D GAUSSIAN 配音

blocks.en: Fig. 4: General pipeline of 3DGS-style 4D scene reconstruction methods. The pipeline presents the representative 4D strategies in explicit 4D primitive-based, deformation-field-based, and frame-wise-training frameworks.
blocks.zh: 费格。 4:3DGS型4D场景重建方法总管. 管道在明确的4D原始基、变形场和帧式训练框架内介绍有代表性的4D战略。

blocks.en: The core challenge in extending 3DGS to the temporal domain lies in parameterizing dynamic scene evolution [ 68 ] . Existing 4D reconstruction frameworks differ in how they model time, ranging from explicit geometric embedding to implicit motion modeling. As shown in Fig. 4 and Table III , these approaches can be grouped into three paradigms: (i) Explicit 4D Primitive-Based Methods , which treat time as a geometric dimension; (ii) Deformation Field-Based Methods , which separate geometry and motion via learned transformations; and (iii) Frame-wise Training Methods , which optimize discrete states for temporal consistency. These paradigms involve trade-offs in flexibility, efficiency, and temporal coherence.
blocks.zh: 将3DGS扩展至时间域的核心挑战在于将动态场景演化参数化[68]. 现有的4D重建框架在建模时间上有所不同,从明显的几何嵌入到隐含的运动建模. 如图4和表三所示,这些方法可分为三个范式:(一) 明确的4D优先方法,将时间作为几何维度对待;(二) 变形场方法,通过学习的转化将几何和运动分开;(三) 框架式培训方法,通过时间一致性优化离散状态。 这些模式涉及灵活性、效率和时间一致性方面的权衡。

blocks.en: IV-A Fundamentals of 4DGS
blocks.zh: 4DGS的基本要素

blocks.en: The standard 3DGS framework represents scenes using static primitives, limiting its applicability to stationary environments [ 174 ] . Extending to the 4D spatio-temporal domain requires modeling the evolution of scene attributes—position, rotation, and appearance—over time. Existing methods differ in how this temporal evolution is formulated.
blocks.zh: 标准3DGS框架代表了使用静态原始物的场景,限制了其对静态环境的适用性[174]. 扩展至4Dspatio-时空域需要模拟场景属性的演化——位置、旋转和外观——随着时间推移。 现有方法在时间演变方式上有所不同。

blocks.en: IV-B Explicit 4D Primitive-Based Methods
blocks.zh: 四-B 明确的4D 初级方法

blocks.en: These methods extend 3D Gaussian Splatting by incorporating time directly into Gaussian primitives. Combined with temporal slicing and tile-based rasterization, they achieve high reconstruction quality and temporal coherence.
blocks.zh: 这些方法通过将时间直接纳入高斯原始体来延长3D高斯白板化. 它们与时间切片和基于瓦片的光栅化相结合,实现了高重建质量和时间一致性。

blocks.en: 4DGS [ 172 ] generalizes 3DGS to 4D by treating time as an additional dimension. It uses 4D scaling and dual quaternions for rotation, and renders by slicing 4D Gaussians into conditional 3D Gaussians.
blocks.zh: 4DGS [172]通过将时间作为额外的维度来概括3DGS到4D. 它使用4D缩放和双弦进行旋转,并通过将4D高斯人切成有条件的3D高斯人.

blocks.en: Subsequent works refine spatial–temporal disentanglement. 4D-RotorGS [ 22 ] adopts rotor-based rotation with entropy regularization, while SpaceTimeGS [ 74 ] models topology changes using temporal basis functions and compact feature decoding.
blocks.zh: 随后的作品完善了空间-时空分离. 4D-RotorGS [22] 采用转子制旋转方式,并采用py定态,而SpaceTimeGS [74] 模型地形变化则使用时间基础函数和紧凑特征解码.

blocks.en:
To better capture motion, CD-3DGS [ 53 ] and FreeTimeGS [ 148 ] parameterize motion using Fourier or linear functions, with additional supervision such as optical flow. SplatFlow [ 134 ] further incorporates learned motion flow fields.
In order to improve robustness, DriveDreamer4D [ 185 ] and DeSiRe-GS [ 108 ] introduce external supervision, including synthetic data and motion-aware decomposition, to handle occlusions and sparse observations.
blocks.zh:
为了更好地捕捉运动,CD-3DGS [53] 和FreeTimeGS [148] 使用Fourier或线性函数参数化运动,同时增加光学流等监督. SplateFlow [134] 进一步融入了学到的运动流场.
为了提高稳健性,DriveDreamer4D[185]和DeSiRe-GS[108]引入了外部监督,包括合成数据和运动感知分解,处理隔离和稀疏观测.

blocks.en: Explicit 4D primitive-based methods directly embed time into Gaussian parameterization, achieving strong temporal consistency through conditional slicing of 4D Gaussians into 3D counterparts [ 172 ] . Combined with tile-based rasterization, this formulation enables efficient real-time rendering. Extensions such as temporal basis functions [ 74 ] and rotor-based rotation with entropy regularization [ 22 ] further improve spatio-temporal disentanglement and topology modeling. However, the higher per-primitive parameter dimensionality introduces substantial memory overhead, as each Gaussian requires a 4D mean and a 4 × 4 4\times 4 covariance matrix. These methods are particularly suitable for indoor dynamic scenes with dense multi-view capture and real-time rendering requirements.
blocks.zh: 明晰的4D原始基方法直接将时间嵌入高斯参数化,通过有条件的将4D高斯人切成3D对应物[172],实现强烈的时间一致性. 这种配方与基于瓦片的光栅化相结合,能够有效实时渲染。 时间基函数[74]和转子基旋转等延展功能与py正态[22]进一步完善了斯皮提奥-时空分解和地形模型. 然而,更高的每原生参数维度引入了大量的内存超高,因为每个高斯人都需要一个4D平均值和一个4×4 4\4的共变矩阵. 这些方法特别适合室内动态场景,具有密集的多视图捕捉和实时渲染要求.

blocks.zh: 表三:基于3DGS的4D动态场景重建方法概述. 方法分为三类。 对于每一种方法,我们都要总结其关键组成部分和额外的前科。

blocks.en: IV-C Deformation-Field-Based Methods
blocks.zh: IV-C 变形-外地方法

blocks.en: Deformation field-based methods model dynamics by applying a learnable deformation field to a canonical set of 3D Gaussians, typically implemented as an MLP. This approach decouples appearance from motion by predicting only the temporal changes in position, rotation, and scale, while assuming other Gaussian attributes remain fixed.
blocks.zh: 基于变形场的方法通过将一个可学习的变形场应用到3D Gaussians的犬科组上来模拟动态,一般作为MLP执行. 这种方法通过只预测位置,旋转,和尺度的时间变化来解脱外观与运动,同时假设其他高斯属性保持不变.

blocks.en: Deformable 3D-GS [ 173 ] introduces deformation fields into 3DGS by mapping Gaussians to a canonical space and using an MLP to predict position, scale, and rotation offsets, with annealing to reduce rendering jitter. Subsequent works improve efficiency and structural consistency through sparse control. SC-GS [ 48 ] and SP-GS [ 142 ] drive dense Gaussians using sparse control points and superpoints, respectively, while GaussianPrediction [ 184 ] employs graph convolutional networks on clustered key points for motion prediction. Feature encoding is further optimized by 4D-GS [ 153 ] , which uses K-Planes with voxel encoding, and GaGS [ 92 ] , which combines point-based MLPs with voxel U-Nets for geometry-aware features.
blocks.zh: 可变形的3D-GS [173] 将变形场引入3DGS,方法是将高斯人映射到一个犬形空间,并使用MLP来预测位置,尺度,和旋转的抵消,同时进行反射以减少渲染的紧张. 随后的工程通过零散的控制提高了效率和结构一致性. SC-GS [48]和SP-GS [142]分别使用稀疏的控制点和超点驱动稠密的高斯人,而高斯预测 [184] 则在集群的关键点上使用图革命网络进行运动预测. 特性编码由4D-GS [153] 进一步优化,它使用带有 voxel 编码的 K- Planes,和 GaGS [92] 结合点基 MLPs 与 voxel U-Nets 用于几何感知特性.

blocks.en: To reduce artifacts from global deformation, several methods separate static and dynamic components. GauFRe [ 77 ] and SWinGS [ 127 ] restrict deformation to dynamic regions. HUGS [ 191 ] models static backgrounds and dynamic objects with separate parameterizations. Gflow [ 147 ] and EfficientGS [ 84 ] further incorporate priors such as depth and optical flow to localize deformable regions.
blocks.zh: 为了减少全球变形的文物,几种方法将静态和动态组件分开. GauFre[77]和SWINGS[127]将变形限制在动态区域. HUGS [191] 模型的静态背景和动态对象具有独立的参数化. Gflow [147] 和高效GS [84] 进一步纳入了深度和光学流量等前科,使可变形区域本地化.

blocks.en: Hierarchical methods address multi-scale dynamics. Grid4D [ 158 ] decomposes spatiotemporal encoding using hash grids and attention. MoDec-GS [ 59 ] and Hicom [ 37 ] adopt global-to-local cascades, while ADC-GS [ 46 ] uses anchor-driven deformation to combine transformations with local refinement.
blocks.zh: 分级方法处理多尺度动态. Grid4D [158] 利用散列网格和注意力分解spatiotemporal编码. MoDec-GS [59]和Hicom [37]采用全局对本地级级联,而ADC-GS [46]则采用锚点驱动变形,将变形与本地精细化相结合.

blocks.en: In addition, external priors and structured models are introduced to regularize deformation. MotionGS [ 195 ] and MoDGS [ 111 ] use optical flow decomposition. BARD-GS [ 91 ] and 4D-GS Wild [ 55 ] address challenging scenarios with pose interpolation and diffusion-based regularization. TaylorGaussian [ 43 ] , Gaussian-Flow [ 81 ] , and SplineGS [ 104 ] model motion using analytic representations, while FreeGave [ 70 ] enforces physical constraints.
blocks.zh: 此外,引入了外部前科和结构化模型,以规范变形. MotionGS [195]和MoDGS [111]使用光学流分解. BARD-GS [91] 和 4D-GS Wild [55] 处理具有挑战性的假设情况,其构成是内插和基于传播的规范化。 Taylor Gausian [43],高斯-弗劳 [81],和SplineGS [104] 使用分析表达的模型运动,而FreeGave [70]则执行物理约束.

blocks.en: Specialized designs target specific scenarios. SpectroMotion [ 24 ] handles specular materials, while GIFStream [ 66 ] and MoSca [ 63 ] enable efficient streaming. Marbles [ 130 ] and MonoFusion [ 150 ] address monocular settings with simplified primitives and motion models. OmniRe [ 15 ] adopts neural scene graphs to separate static and dynamic components under a shared deformation field.
blocks.zh: 专门设计针对特定情景. SpectroMotion [24] 处理光谱材料,而GIFStream [66]和MoSca [63] 则能够高效流线. 大理石 [130] 和 MonoFusion [150] 以简化的原始和运动模型处理单体设置. OmniRe [15] 采用神经场景图,在一个共享的变形场下分离静态和动态组件.

blocks.en: Deformation-field-based methods decouple temporal dynamics from canonical geometry by predicting per-Gaussian attribute offsets through a learnable deformation network [ 173 ] , offering improved parameter efficiency over explicit 4D primitives. This formulation is particularly effective for modeling non-rigid motion and view-dependent specularities. However, MLP-based deformation prediction may introduce rendering jitter, while the additional network inference can limit rendering speed. As one of the most widely explored paradigms, deformation-field-based methods are well-suited for scenes with non-rigid motion and complex appearance changes, and naturally support downstream tasks such as scene editing [ 48 , 60 ] and neural scene graph decomposition [ 15 ] .
blocks.zh: 基于变形场的方法通过预测每个古西人的属性通过可学习变形网络抵消[173],将时间动力学与犬形几何脱钩,提供比显式4D原始物更高的参数效率. 这种配方对于模拟非刚性运动和视差依赖的谱系特别有效. 然而,基于MLP的变形预测可能会引入渲染快感,而附加的网络推论可以限制渲染速度. 作为最广泛探索的范式之一,基于变形场的方法非常适合有非刚性运动和复杂外观变化的场景,自然支持场景编辑[48,60]和神经场景图分解[15]等下游任务.

blocks.en: IV-D Frame-Wise Training Methods
blocks.zh: IV-D 框架集成培训方法

blocks.en: Frame-wise methods optimize 3D Gaussians independently at each timestamp via per-frame reconstruction, optionally incorporating inter-frame constraints for temporal consistency. These approaches are simple and flexible but often incur high storage cost and limited long-term coherence.
blocks.zh: 框架式方法通过每帧重建,在每次时间戳上独立优化3D Gaussians,可选地纳入时间一致性的框架间限制. 这些办法既简单又灵活,但往往需要高昂的储存成本和有限的长期一致性。

blocks.en: D-3DG [ 93 ] models Gaussian centers and orientations as time-varying, while keeping color, opacity, and scale fixed. Motion is guided by rigidity and rotation priors. However, independent optimization can lead to weak temporal consistency and high storage overhead.
blocks.zh: D-3DG [93] 将高斯中心与方向作为时间变化的模型,同时保持颜色,不透明,和尺度的固定. 动议以僵硬性和旋转前缀为指南。 然而,独立优化可能导致时间一致性弱和存储费高。

blocks.en: To reduce redundancy in complex scenes, many methods adopt dynamic–static decomposition. Street Gaussians [ 162 ] and DrivingGaussian [ 193 ] use graph-based representations to separate static backgrounds and dynamic objects [ 12 ] . Casual-FVS [ 62 ] decomposes scenes into static planes and dynamic points with flow-based blending, while LiveSplats [ 47 ] employs hierarchical optimization for real-time processing.
blocks.zh: 为了减少复杂场景中的冗余,许多方法采用动态-静态分解. 街道高斯人[162]和驾驶高斯人[193]使用基于图表的表示法来区分静态背景和动态物体[12]. Casual-FVS [62] 将场景分解为静态平面和动态点,采用流式混合,而LiveSplats [47] 采用分级优化进行实时处理.

blocks.en: For online scenarios with topology changes, 3DGStream [ 132 ] introduces a Neural Transformation Cache to transform existing Gaussians and incrementally add new ones. 4D-Fly [ 152 ] propagates Gaussians across frames using anchor-based updates, expanding the representation only when needed.
blocks.zh: 对于带有地形变化的在线情景,3DGStream [132] 引入了神经变换缓存来改造现有的高斯人,并逐渐添加新的. 4D飞 [152] 宣传 高斯人跨帧使用基于锚基的更新,仅在需要时才扩展代表.

blocks.en:
In order to reduce storage, interpolation-based methods use keyframes. Ex4DGS [ 61 ] and 4DGC [ 44 ] reconstruct intermediate frames via interpolation or motion prediction. Ex4DGS applies CHip and Slerp for trajectory smoothing, while 4DGC uses multi-resolution motion grids for efficient transformation estimation.
On the other hand, several methods incorporate strong supervision to enforce temporal consistency. GaussianFlow [ 38 ] enforces consistency between 3D motion and 2D observations via optical flow. MAGS [ 40 ] further improve supervision using dense correspondences and uncertainty-aware flow modeling.
blocks.zh:
为了减少存储,基于插值的方法使用键框. Ex4DGS [61]和4DGC [44]通过内插或运动预测重建中间帧. Ex4DGS将CHip和Slerp用于轨迹平滑,而4DGC则使用多分辨率运动网格用于高效的转换估计.
另一方面,若干方法包括强有力的监督,以落实时间一致性。 高斯福[38]通过光学流执行3D运动和2D观测的一致性. MAGS [40] 利用密集的函证和对不确定性认识的流量模型,进一步改善监督.

blocks.en: Frame-wise methods provide architectural simplicity and flexibility by optimizing 3D Gaussians independently at each timestamp, with dynamic set updates ( 𝒢 t = 𝒢 ^ ∗ t ∪ 𝒢 ∗ new \mathcal{G}_{t}=\hat{\mathcal{G}}*t\cup\mathcal{G}*{\text{new}} ) that naturally handle topology changes [ 132 , 152 ] . This design is particularly suitable for online and streaming scenarios. However, the independent per-frame parameterization results in storage costs that grow linearly with sequence length, while long-range temporal coherence remains limited without explicit inter-frame coupling. Keyframe interpolation [ 61 , 44 ] and flow-supervised consistency losses [ 40 ] partially alleviate these issues, but introduce approximation errors or reliance on external priors. Consequently, this paradigm is best suited for short sequences, casual monocular videos [ 62 ] , and streaming reconstruction tasks where real-time adaptability is prioritized over long-term temporal consistency [ 119 , 125 ] .
blocks.zh: 框架式方法通过在每个时标上独立优化3D Gaussians,提供建筑的简单性和灵活性,具有动态集更新(G t = G ^ ^ → G → G → g → 新的\ mathcal{ G}_{t}=\t\ tup → mathcal{ G}*{\t}*{\ttext{ new}} → ),可以自然处理地形变化[132, 152]. 这种设计特别适合在线和流线情景。 然而,独立的每帧参数化导致存储成本随着序列长度的线性增长,而远程时间一致性仍然有限,没有明确的帧间耦合. 关键框架插值[61,44]和流量监督一致性损失[40]部分缓解了这些问题,但引入了近似误差或依赖外部前科. 因此,这一模式最适合短序、临时单视视频[62]和流畅的重建任务,即实时适应优先于长期时间一致性[119,125]。

blocks.en: V Performance Evaluation
blocks.zh: 五 考绩

blocks.en: In this section, we summarize representative datasets for dynamic scene synthesis, categorizing them according to key properties and research objectives (Table IV ). In addition, we explore novel view synthesis and geometric reconstruction in representative benchmarks, highlighting the best results as first , second , and third . We organize quantitative data from papers with a common evaluation protocol and cross-verified results. Since some works do not release codes or specific configurations, our priority is to include papers with consistent benchmarks, ensuring a reliable basis for verifiable comparison with a shared evaluation framework across multiple sources.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们总结了动态场景合成的代表性数据集,按照关键属性和研究目标对其进行分类(表四. 此外,我们探索以具有代表性的基准进行新观点综合和几何重建,突出显示第一、第二和第三阶段的最佳结果。 我们从有共同评价协议和交叉核实结果的文件中整理数量数据。 由于一些工作没有发布代码或具体配置,我们的优先事项是纳入具有一致基准的文件,确保有一个可靠的基础,用于与多个来源的共同评价框架进行可核查的比较。

blocks.en: TABLE IV: Taxonomy of dynamic scene datasets based on benchmark properties. Datasets are grouped by their primary research focus and capture characteristics.
blocks.zh: 表格 四:基于基准属性的动态场景数据集分类学. 数据集按其主要研究重点和捕捉特征进行分组.

blocks.en: V-A Benchmark Datasets
blocks.zh: V-A 基准数据集

blocks.en: V-A 1 Synthetic vs. Real-world Data
blocks.zh: V-A 1 合成对现实世界数据

blocks.en: Synthetic: D-NeRF [ 110 ] and ParticleNeRF [ 1 ] provide clean articulated and deformable scenes, making them suitable for evaluating deformation modeling and motion tracking. In autonomous driving, SS3DM [ 45 ] offers synchronized RGB, LiDAR, and semantic annotations, enabling controlled evaluation of multimodal fusion methods. However, limited domain diversity and simplified rendering reduce their ability to assess real-world robustness.
blocks.zh: 合成:D-NERF[110]和ParticleNERF[1]提供清晰的清晰可变的场景,使其适合评价变形模型和运动跟踪. 在自主驱动中,SS3DM [45] 提供同步RGB,LiDAR,和语义说明,能够对多式联运聚变方法进行控制评价. 然而,有限的领域多样性和简化渲染降低了它们评估现实世界稳健性的能力。

blocks.en: Real-world: HyperNeRF [ 106 ] and Technicolor [ 116 ] introduce complex lighting, calibration errors, and dynamic backgrounds. These datasets are more suitable for evaluating generalization and robustness, but often lack accurate ground truth, making quantitative evaluation more challenging.
blocks.zh: 真实世界:HyperNERF [106]和Technicolor [116]引入了复杂的照明,校准错误,以及动态背景. 这些数据集更适合评价概括性和稳健性,但往往缺乏准确的地面真相,使得定量评价更具挑战性.

blocks.en: V-A 2 Monocular vs. Multi-view Capture
blocks.zh: V-A 2 独角兽对多视图捕捉

blocks.en: Monocular: D-NeRF [ 110 ] , HyperNeRF [ 106 ] , and DAVIS [ 109 ] contain sequences captured from a single moving camera. These benchmarks are well-suited for evaluating methods that rely on strong priors, such as generative models or deformation-aware representations. However, monocular setups often suffer from scale ambiguity and limited spatial coverage.
blocks.zh: 单曲:D-NERF [110],HyperNERF [106],DAVIS [109] 包含从单个移动相机中捕获的序列. 这些基准非常适合评估依赖强前科的方法,如基因模型或变形-知形表示. 然而,单体结构往往受到规模模糊和空间覆盖有限的影响。

blocks.en: Multi-view: Panoptic Studio [ 52 ] and Google Immersive [ 5 ] provide dense spatial coverage, making them suitable for evaluating reconstruction fidelity and view consistency. Intermediate-scale datasets such as NeRF-DS [ 163 ] and KITTI [ 39 ] instead offer sparse multi-view setups that better reflect real-world constraints and are useful for evaluating view-sparse reconstruction methods.
blocks.zh: 多视图:泛光工作室[52]和Google Immersive[5]提供密集的空间覆盖,使其适合评价重建忠诚度和视图一致性. NERF-DS[163]和KITTI[39]等中尺度数据集反而提供了稀少的多视图设置,更好地反映现实世界的制约因素,并对评价视图平整重建方法有用.

blocks.en: V-A 3 Short-term vs. Long-term Horizons
blocks.zh: V-A 3 短期对长期视野

blocks.en: Short Horizon: Neu3DV [ 72 ] and Meeting Room [ 95 ] typically contain short clips with localized motions. These datasets are well-suited for evaluating deformation modeling and short-term motion consistency, but may not capture long-range dynamics.
blocks.zh: 短地平线:Neu3DV[72]和会议室[95]一般包含带有局部运动的短片段. 这些数据集非常适合评价变形模型和短期运动一致性,但可能无法捕捉远程动态.

blocks.en: Long Horizon: Argoverse 2 [ 151 ] and nuScenes [ 6 ] provide large-scale temporal data across diverse driving environments. These benchmarks are useful for evaluating temporal consistency and long-term prediction, although sparse viewpoints and noisy annotations introduce additional challenges.
blocks.zh: Long Horizon:Argoverse 2 [151]和nuScens [6]提供了跨越不同驱动环境的大规模时间数据. 这些基准对评价时间一致性和长期预测很有用,尽管观点少见和说明吵闹带来更多的挑战。

blocks.en: V-A 4 Human-Centric vs. General Dynamic Scenes
blocks.zh: V-A 4 人与儿童对一般动态场景

blocks.en: Human-Centric: Panoptic Studio [ 52 ] and ENeRF-Outdoor [ 80 ] focus on articulated human motion. These datasets are particularly suitable for evaluating deformation modeling, skeletal motion tracking, and fine-grained geometry reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 人-子:泛视工作室 [52] 和 ENERF-Outdoor [80] 专注于清晰的人类运动. 这些数据集特别适合评价变形模型,骨骼运动跟踪,以及精细的几何重建.

blocks.en: General Dynamics: NVIDIA Dynamic Scene [ 176 ] and Stereo4D [ 51 ] include diverse dynamic elements such as animals, fluids, and object interactions. These datasets better reflect real-world complexity, but introduce greater challenges for motion decomposition and scene understanding.
blocks.zh: General Dynamics:NVIDIA Dynamic Scene [176] and Stereo4D [51] 包含动物,流体,物体相互作用等多种动态元素. 这些数据集更好地反映了现实世界的复杂性,但对运动分解和场景理解提出了更大的挑战.

blocks.en: V-A 5 RGB-only vs. Multimodal Datasets
blocks.zh: V-A 5 RGB 仅对多式联运数据集

blocks.en: RGB-only: Technicolor [ 116 ] and WayveScenes101 [ 196 ] rely solely on visual inputs. These benchmarks are suitable for evaluating appearance modeling, but suffer from depth ambiguity and sensitivity to lighting variations.
blocks.zh: 仅RGB:Technicolor [116]和WayveScens101 [196] 完全依靠视觉输入. 这些基准适合评价外观模型,但有深度模糊和对照明变化的敏感性.

blocks.en: Multimodal: Waymo Open Dataset [ 133 ] , PandaSet [ 156 ] , and OmniHD-Scenes [ 188 ] integrate LiDAR, radar, and IMU signals, making them suitable for evaluating geometric accuracy and robust reconstruction under challenging conditions. DyCheck [ 35 ] further incorporates smartphone LiDAR, enabling evaluation in lightweight capture settings.
blocks.zh: 多式联运: Waymo Open Dataset [133],PandaSet [156],以及OmniHD-Scenses [188] 集成LiDAR,雷达,和IMU信号,使其适合评价几何精度和在挑战性条件下的强力重建. DyCheck [35] 进一步融入智能手机LiDAR,使得在轻量级捕获设置中能够进行评价.

blocks.en: V-B Evaluation Metrics
blocks.zh: V-B 评价计量

blocks.en: Evaluation of 4D reconstruction involves three primary aspects: rendering quality, geometric accuracy, and computational efficiency. We adopt widely used metrics in the literature and further analyze their strengths and limitations for dynamic 4D reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 对4D重建的评价涉及三个主要方面:质量、几何精确度和计算效率。 我们在文献中采用广泛使用的衡量标准,并进一步分析它们对于动态四维重建的优点和局限性。

blocks.en: V-B 1 View Synthesis Metrics
blocks.zh: V-B 1 视图综合计量

blocks.en: PSNR measures reconstruction fidelity through pixel-wise error. Although widely used for novel view synthesis, it primarily evaluates per-frame appearance quality and does not fully capture temporal consistency in dynamic scenes.
blocks.zh: PSNR通过像素偏差来测量重建的忠诚度. 虽然被广泛用于新颖的视图合成,但它主要评价每帧外观质量,不能完全捕捉动态场景中的时间一致性.

blocks.en: SSIM evaluates perceptual similarity in terms of structure and contrast. Compared to PSNR, it better reflects structural preservation, but remains a frame-wise metric without explicit temporal modeling.
blocks.zh: SSIM在结构和对比方面评价了知觉相似性. 与PSNR相比,它更好地反映了结构保存,但仍是一个没有明确时间模型的帧度量.

blocks.en: LPIPS measures perceptual similarity using deep feature representations. While it correlates better with human perception, it mainly evaluates appearance quality rather than dynamic geometric accuracy.
blocks.zh: LPIPS利用深层特征表示测量知觉相似性. 虽然它与人类的感知联系较好,但主要评价外观质量而不是动态几何精度.

blocks.en: V-B 2 Geometric and Spatiotemporal Metrics
blocks.zh: V-B 2 几何和几何计量

blocks.en: Chamfer Distance (CD) measures geometric similarity between predicted and ground-truth point sets. It is widely used to evaluate geometric fidelity, but remains sensitive to point density and may not adequately capture topology changes in dynamic scenes.
blocks.zh: Chamfer距离(CD)测量预测和地面真实点组之间的几何相似性。 它被广泛用于评价几何忠诚度,但对点密度仍然敏感,可能无法充分捕捉动态场景的地形变化.

blocks.en: F-Score evaluates reconstruction quality through precision and recall under a distance threshold. It provides a more balanced assessment of geometric accuracy, although the results can vary with threshold selection.
blocks.zh: F-Score在距离阈值下通过精度和召回来评价重建质量. 它为几何精度提供了更为平衡的评估,虽然结果可以随阈值选择而变化.

blocks.en: RMSE measures the error between predicted and ground-truth geometry. While it offers a direct measure of geometric accuracy, it is sensitive to outliers and may not fully reflect perceptual quality.
blocks.zh: RMSE测量预测和地面真实几何之间的误差. 虽然它提供了几何精度的直接测量,但它对外界敏感,可能不能充分反映知觉质量.

blocks.en: V-B 3 Efficiency and Practicality
blocks.zh: V-B 3 效率和实用性

blocks.en: FPS measures inference speed and computational efficiency. However, FPS alone does not capture other practical factors such as memory consumption and scalability, which are also critical in 4D reconstruction.
blocks.zh: FPS测量推论速度和计算效率. 然而,单是FPS并不能捕捉其他实际因素,如记忆消耗和可伸缩性,这些因素在4D重建中也至关重要.

blocks.en: Despite these limitations, these metrics remain widely adopted in existing 4D reconstruction works and provide a common basis for comparison. However, the lack of standardized protocols for evaluating temporal coherence, topology changes, and long-term consistency remains an open challenge in dynamic 4D reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 尽管存在这些局限性,这些衡量标准在现有的4D重建工程中仍然得到广泛采用,并为比较提供了共同的基础。 然而,缺乏用于评价时间一致性、地形变化和长期一致性的标准化协议,仍然是动态四维重建中的一个公开挑战。

blocks.zh: V-C 小说视图合成

DyNeRF establishes a strong baseline, while MSTH and DaReNeRF further advance the state of the art. A notable trend is the strong performance of 4D feature-volume-based architectures, which consistently achieve leading results across multiple metrics. In addition, specialized designs highlight the benefits of structured priors; for example, the uncertainty-aware modeling in MSTH and the semantic segmentation constraints in Gear-NeRF demonstrate the effectiveness of incorporating probabilistic cues and geometric semantics into dynamic scene optimization.
blocks.zh: 神经3D. 图表 V在[72]协议下报告NERF式的结果. 从早期隐含模式到最近的混合方法,业绩稳步改善。 DyNeRF建立了坚实的基线,而MSTH和DaReNeRF则进一步推进了最新水平. 一个显著的趋势是,基于4D特性量的架构表现强劲,在多个衡量标准中始终取得领先成果。 此外,专门设计突出了结构化前缀的好处;例如MSTH中的不确定性意识模型和Gear-NeRF中的语义分解限制证明了将概率提示和几何语义纳入动态场景优化的有效性.

blocks.en:
Table VI presents results for 3DGS-based methods. Recent approaches, such as FreeTimeGS and TaylorGaussian, outperform earlier methods in PSNR while maintaining strong perceptual quality. Deformation-based methods also perform competitively: ADC-GS achieves the best SSIM, and ED-3DGS yields strong LPIPS scores. A key observation from the evaluation is the performance improvement enabled by integrating external priors. In addition, specialized frameworks highlight the effectiveness of structured constraints; for example, the feature matching priors in FreeTimeGS, which achieves high rendering fidelity, and the optical flow constraints used in ST-4DGS and CD-3DGS demonstrate the benefits of external guidance for dynamic scene optimization. These priors effectively regularize Gaussian primitives in highly dynamic regions, reducing floaters and multi-view inconsistencies commonly observed in purely photometric optimization.
Figure 8 shows qualitative comparisons on Neu3D.

表六列出了基于3DGS方法的结果。 最近的方法,如FreetimeGS和Taylor Gausian,在PSNR中比早先的方法要好,同时保持强烈的认知质量. 基于变形的方法也具有竞争力:ADC-GS实现最好的SSIM,而ED-3DGS则能产生强大的LPIPS分数. 从评价中得出的一个关键意见是通过整合外部前科提高业绩。 此外,专业框架强调结构约束的有效性;例如,FreeTimeGS中的特性匹配前缀,实现了高渲染忠心度,ST-4DGS和CD-3DGS中使用的光学流约束,显示了外部指导对动态场景优化的好处. 这些前传有效地规范了高度动态地区的高斯原始人,减少了在纯光度优化中通常观察到的浮标和多视图不一致.

Table VII reports reconstruction quality under the protocol of [ 110 ] , showing that 4D feature-volume-based methods consistently achieve state-of-the-art performance across diverse dynamic benchmarks. While earlier approaches such as TiNeuVox establish strong baselines, Ced-NeRF and SLS4D leverage semi-explicit representations and high-dimensional feature volumes to better disentangle static geometry from temporal dynamics. This trend reflects a broader shift in modeling small-scale dynamic indoor scenes, where grid-based feature structures outperform purely coordinate-based MLPs.

blocks.en: NeRF-DS . Table VIII reports rendering performance under the protocol of [ 163 ] . EfficientGS achieves the best results, while motion-aware methods such as MotionGS and DN-4DGS perform strongly on dynamic regions. This trend highlights the effectiveness of deformation-field-based representations for explicit 4D modeling. By decoupling temporal motion from canonical geometry, these methods avoid the parameter growth associated with unified 4D primitives. Moreover, this formulation is well-suited for modeling complex non-rigid dynamics and view-dependent specularities, which are particularly challenging in the NeRF-DS dataset.

blocks.en: NVIDIA Dynamic Scene Dataset . Qualitative evaluations in unstructured, in-the-wild environments (Fig. 7 ) highlight the strong performance of frameworks incorporating geometric priors. DynNeRF maintains superior free-view consistency and temporal stability, largely due to its use of multi-view constraints and 3D scene flow for regularization. This demonstrates the effectiveness of geometric priors in dynamic scene reconstruction.

blocks.en: Waymo . As illustrated in Figure 6 , general-purpose 4D reconstruction methods often struggle with distant or fast-moving objects in large-scale driving scenes, leading to ghosting artifacts or geometric collapse. In contrast, EmerNeRF achieves more robust results by integrating 3D scene flow with DINOv2 features, providing a more stable optimization signal and improved robustness to lighting variations. OmniRE further delivers high-fidelity reconstruction by incorporating category-specific semantic priors for human modeling, effectively constraining the solution space to physically plausible structures. These results highlight the importance of semantic guidance and structural priors for 4D reconstruction under limited viewpoint overlap.
blocks.zh: 韦莫。 如图6所示,通用的4D重建方法经常在大型驾驶场景中与远方或快速移动的物体发生斗争,导致文物幽灵或几何崩溃. 相比之下,EmerNeRF通过将3D场景流与DINOv2特性融合,提供更稳定的优化信号,提高照明变体的稳健性,从而实现了更强的效果. OmniRE通过将特定类别的语义学前科纳入人类建模,进一步提供高真性重建,有效地将溶液空间限制在物理上可行的结构上. 这些结果突出了在有限观点重叠的情况下4D重建的语义指导和结构前科的重要性.

blocks.en: V-D Geometric Reconstruction
blocks.zh: V-D 几何重建

blocks.en: We evaluate geometric fidelity using surface extraction and point-based metrics, considering both vision-only and vision-LiDAR methods. For image-based methods, we follow the D-NeRF [ 110 ] surface extraction pipeline. For vision–LiDAR methods, we directly compute point cloud error via nearest-neighbor distance. Meshes are extracted from SDF zero-crossings using marching cubes [ 87 ] . We report Chamfer Distance (CD), RMSE, and F1-score (F1) with a 5 cm threshold.
blocks.zh: 我们利用地表提取和以点为基础的度量法来评价几何忠诚度,同时考虑光线和光线-LiDAR方法。 对于基于图像的方法,我们遵循D-NERF[110]地表提取管道. 对于视觉-LiDAR方法,我们直接通过近邻距离计算点云错误. Meshes是从SDF0-cross中提取出来的,使用游行立方体[87]. 我们报告Chamfer距离(CD)、RMSE和F1-分数(F1)的阈值为5厘米。

blocks.en: NuScenes . Evaluations on the NuScenes dataset (Table IX ) show that frameworks incorporating LiDAR supervision significantly outperform vision-only approaches, highlighting the importance of active depth sensing for resolving scale ambiguities in large-scale environments. STGC-NeRF and LiDAR4D achieve the lowest global geometric error (Fig. 5 ) by leveraging spatio-temporal flow and surface normal priors for reconstruction regularization. Furthermore, the 3DGS-based OmniRE yields superior local depth accuracy and robustness to outliers, suggesting that deformation-field-based representations are effective for capturing fine geometric details and preserving structural integrity in dynamic driving scenes.

blocks.en: V-E Model Efficiency
blocks.zh: V-E 模式效率

blocks.en:
We evaluate efficiency using GPU memory (peak GB), FPS, and training time on four NVIDIA A100 GPUs. Table X summarizes results for NeRF-style and 3DGS-style methods on Neu3D.
Among NeRF-style methods, DevRF and StreamRF are the most efficient due to voxel-based representations and compact temporal encoding. In contrast, 3DGS-based methods achieve higher rendering speed owing to efficient rasterization, with 4DRotorGS attaining the highest FPS.
Overall, 3DGS-based methods offer superior speed but require larger model capacity, while NeRF-style methods are more memory-efficient at the cost of slower rendering.

blocks.en: VI Future Prospects
blocks.zh: 六. 未来前景

blocks.en: VI-A Technical Prospects
blocks.zh: VI-A 技术前景

blocks.en: Feed-Forward 4D Representations. Existing NeRF and Gaussian Splatting methods largely rely on per-scene optimization, resulting in high computational cost and limited scalability. A major trend is the transition toward generalizable feed-forward models. By leveraging large reconstruction models and transformer-based architectures [ 76 , 183 , 79 , 159 ] , the field is gradually shifting from optimizing individual scenes to directly inferring scene representations. This paradigm enables near real-time 4D reconstruction from sparse inputs and helps bridge low-level reconstruction with higher-level spatio-temporal understanding.
blocks.zh: Feed-Forward 4D 显示器. 现有的 NERF 和 Gaussian 镀层方法主要依赖于每层的优化,导致高计算成本和有限的可伸缩性. 一个主要趋势是向通用的饲料型号过渡。 通过利用大型重建模型和基于变压器的建筑[76,183,79,159],现场逐渐从优化单个场景转向直接推断场景表现. 这一模式使得人们能够利用稀少的投入进行近实时的4D重建,并有助于利用更高级别的时空理解来连接低层次的重建。

blocks.en: Hybrid Explicit–Implicit Representations. The distinction between explicit and implicit representations is increasingly converging toward hybrid paradigms. Future 4D models are expected to combine explicit structures for efficient rasterization with implicit latent fields for modeling non-Lambertian effects and temporal topology changes [ 24 , 28 ] . Such hybrid designs are important for scaling 4D representations to open-world dynamic scenes, where purely explicit methods face memory limitations and purely implicit methods struggle with real-time interaction.
blocks.zh: 混合显证法. 明确和隐含的表述之间的区别日益趋同于混合模式。 未来的4D模型预计将将高效光栅化的显性结构与模拟非兰伯特效应和时间地形变化的隐性潜在领域相结合[24,28]. 此类混合设计对于将4D表示器缩放到开放世界动态场景非常重要,其中纯粹明确的方法面临内存限制,纯粹隐含的方法与实时交互发生斗争.

blocks.en: Integration with Generative Priors. Another emerging direction is the integration of generative models [ 115 , 94 ] into 4D reconstruction pipelines. Unlike traditional optimization-based methods that rely heavily on observations, generative priors enable plausible completion, motion prediction, and view synthesis under sparse or degraded inputs [ 14 , 50 ] . This integration may shift reconstruction from purely observation-driven modeling toward predictive and generative frameworks, leading to more robust 4D reconstruction and synthesis.
blocks.zh: 与基因前传集成. 另一个新出现的方向是将基因模型[115,94]整合到4D重建管道中. 与严重依赖观测的传统优化方法不同,基因学前科使得在稀疏或退化的投入下可以进行可信的完成、运动预测和视图合成[14、50]。 这种整合可能使重建从纯粹的观察驱动模式转向预测性和遗传性框架,导致更强有力的4D重建和综合。

blocks.en: Interactive and Controllable 4D Scenes. Beyond passive reconstruction, future 4D systems are expected to support interaction and controllability [ 48 ] . These capabilities enable users to manipulate dynamic scenes, edit object behaviors, and simulate alternative scenarios. Such developments may transform 4D representations into interactive world models for applications in simulation, digital twins, and content creation.
blocks.zh: 互动与可控 4D Scens. 除了被动重建外,未来的4D系统预计将支持互动和可控性[48]. 这些能力使用户能够操纵动态场景,编辑对象行为,模拟替代情景. 这种发展可能将4D表示转化为模拟、数字双胞胎和内容创建应用的交互式世界模型。

blocks.en: VI-B Application Prospects
blocks.zh: 六-B 应用前景

blocks.en: Embodied AI Simulation. 4D reconstruction enables temporally consistent environments for embodied AI [ 89 , 13 , 132 ] . Compared with static representations, dynamic 4D scenes provide richer interaction signals and more realistic training environments, supporting robust perception, planning, and interaction in complex settings [ 121 , 126 , 123 ] .
blocks.zh: 健美AI模拟. 4D重建为体现的AI[89,13,132]提供了时间上一致的环境. 与静态表示相比,动态4D场景提供了更丰富的互动信号和更现实的训练环境,支持在复杂环境下的强感,规划和互动[121,126,123].

blocks.en: Dynamic Scene Understanding and Editing. 4D representations facilitate scene understanding, navigation, and editing in dynamic environments [ 164 , 145 , 192 ] . By modeling temporal evolution, these methods support motion prediction, scene simulation, and controllable editing for both analysis and content generation.
blocks.zh: 动态场景理解与编辑. 4D表示器在动态环境中有利于场景理解,导航和编辑[164,145,192]. 通过模拟时间演化,这些方法支持运动预测,场景模拟,以及可控编辑,既用于分析和内容生成.

blocks.en: Human-Centered Applications. 4D reconstruction further enables accurate modeling of human motion and interaction [ 26 , 187 , 16 ] . These capabilities support applications in AR/VR, telepresence, healthcare, and digital twins. Future systems may further improve realism and interactivity, enabling more immersive user experiences.
blocks.zh: 以人为本的应用. 4D重建进一步能够准确模拟人类运动和相互作用[26,187,16]. 这些能力支持在AR/VR、远程存在、保健和数码双胞胎方面的应用。 未来的系统可能进一步改善现实主义和互动性,使用户体验到更多的浸润性。

blocks.en: VII Conclusion
blocks.zh: 七. 结论

blocks.en: 4D scene reconstruction advances spatio-temporal 3D vision by modeling dynamic environments. This survey reviews NeRF- and 3DGS-based approaches, analyzing their efficiency, scalability, and temporal coherence. We further summarize representative datasets, evaluation metrics, and existing methods. Finally, we discuss open challenges and future directions, including feed-forward modeling, hybrid representations, and generative priors, as well as applications in embodied AI and dynamic scene understanding. This survey serves as both a reference and a roadmap for future research in 4D scene reconstruction.
blocks.zh: 4D场景重建通过模拟动态环境推进斯皮提奥-时空3D视觉. 本调查审查了基于NERF和3DGS的方法,分析了其效率、可扩展性和时间一致性。 我们进一步总结了有代表性的数据集、评价指标和现有方法。 最后,我们讨论开放的挑战和今后的方向,包括向前进的建模、混合表述和基因前科,以及体现的AI和动态场景理解中的应用。 这一调查既是未来4D场景重建研究的参考,也是路线图.
